raw_output: Answer: Jimmy's approaches to managing his mental health have evolved over time. Initially, he struggled with feelings of shame and frustration after relapsing into old habits, but he found support in his AA friends, particularly Bob, who helped him understand that recovery is a process of improvement, not perfection. Jimmy learned to be gentle with himself and focus on the progress he's made, rather than dwelling on past mistakes. He also began to develop strategies to manage stress, such as setting clearer boundaries and planning his workload. With time, Jimmy has become more confident in his ability to cope with challenges and has learned to lean on his support system when needed.
